about.title: About InternWay
about.lead: InternWay is a platform that connects students and graduates with internships abroad. We help you find the right programme, prepare and apply.
about.goalText: To make finding an international internship, preparing for it and applying simple and clear for every student.

about.experienceText: InternWay is backed by the USTravel team's extensive experience in international programs and student mobility. With established partnerships in Romania and Germany, and country representatives in Italy, South Korea, Malaysia and the United Kingdom, we are building a strong international network to connect students with internship and career opportunities abroad.
